title: This Week in Evermarch: The Chronicle Begins
excerpt: Our first weekly Evermarch update captures the current save flow, an active mining run, and a new public archive that will preserve the game's journey from here.

body.text: Welcome to the first weekly Evermarch update. This is the start of a regular record of what changed, what is taking shape, and what the game looked like along the way. The goal is simple: make the journey visible for players now and easy to revisit in the future.
A public home for the journey

Evermarch now has a dedicated update archive on the Tempest Studios play site. Each post has its own permanent page, search-friendly metadata, and a place for in-game screenshots. Future weekly notes will live alongside the game instead of disappearing into development history.

The screenshots below capture the current playable build: the save selector that lets an adventurer continue a local journey, an offline-progress return with time and rewards credited, and the active mining board with a Rune Essence target, depth tracking, mastery, and an ore unlock rail.

items: Save selection keeps local adventures clear and easy to resume.
Offline progress reports the time away, earned experience, items, and lane activity on return.
Active mining presents a block-face board, depth milestones, target information, and resource progression in one focused play surface.

body.text: We also tightened the app's startup order so local sessions begin authentication before route checks run. That prevents the save screen from waiting on a session that has not had a chance to initialize, making development and local play more reliable.
Next week, this space will focus on the work completed during the week and the most interesting player-visible changes. For now, consider this the first page of Evermarch's public chronicle.
